claims.claim: Spoken / sighted in lat. 44 N lon. 54 W (25th May)
claims.citation: Lloyd's List, 25 June 1866, p. 3, col. 5 (British Newspaper Archive)
New York Herald, 30 May 1866, p. 4, col. 1
claims.verbatim:
By the arrival yesterday of the steamships St. David
off Father Point and Persia at this port we have news
from Europe to the 20th of May, three days later.

claims.citation: New York Herald, 30 May 1866, p. 8, col. 1
claims.verbatim:
The Cunard steamship Persia, Captain Lott, which left
Liverpool at eleven o'clock on the morning of the 19th
and Queenstown on the evening of the 20th of May,
arrived at this port yesterday evening.
